src: visible fragments of overlapping 6x6 outline-ring sprites; sparse off-template colors are marker noise
dst: vertical stack of one completed ring sprite per recovered color
transform: complete every fragment to the 12-pixel ring template using the input background
multi_step: order sprites from top layer to bottom layer: if a color occupies another sprite's expected ring pixel, it is placed earlier
grid_shape: 6 columns; height is 6 times the number of recovered ring sprites
